titel: 219【Dialogue with Masters】Why Is It Harder to Feel Happy?

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts; M4A: Ausschnitte nur als AAC-Bloecke (clips_aac) - eine App ohne ADTS-Umverpackung zeigt keine; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: 探讨为什么随着年龄增长，感受真正的快乐变得愈发困难。
kurzfassung: 本期节目开启表达性艺术治疗大师系列对话。邀请学者 Keren Shechter 博士共同探讨随着年龄增长幸福感减弱的原因。节目探讨了童年纯粹快乐的去向以及如何通过艺术重新建立连接。
stichpunkte: 启动表达性艺术治疗大师系列对话
嘉宾 Keren Shechter 博士的背景与临床经验
探讨随着年龄增长更难感受到快乐的现象
回顾童年时期纯粹的喜悦与活力
通过艺术、身体与关系的整合来理解自我
beschreibung:
英文播客
This is the very first episode of our “EAT Masters” series, and I feel really honored to invite leading voices in Expressive Arts Therapy to join us on Little Art Heart Pills, responding directly to your questions.
Today, we are joined by Dr. Keren Shechter from Lesley University—the academic home of Expressive Arts Therapy. With over 25 years of clinical practice and teaching experience, she’s here to explore a question many of us carry:
Why does it become harder to feel genuine happiness as we grow older? Where did all that joy we had as children go?
In this episode, you might just find a key to reconnect with that sense of joy… and a way to reawaken the vitality within. Don’t miss it.
Dr. Keren Shechter, is an experienced registered expressive arts therapist, specializing in psychodrama, with over 25 years of clinical and professional experience. She has worked extensively with children, adolescents, and adults across various settings, including schools, community clinics, and mental health services. She currently teaches in the Expressive Arts Therapy master program at Lesley University in the United States, and also teaches as William James College and Cambridge College, where she supports the training of future expressive arts therapists. Her work integrates art, body, and relationship, using creative process to help people deepen self-understanding and connect with others.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Starting today, we’re launching a two-month special series: 「Expressive Arts Therapy — Conversations with Masters」
As a graduate of the first cohort of the China–U.S. Expressive Arts Therapy training program, I feel deeply honored to invite six leading figures in the field—senior practitioners, professors, and educators actively engaged in both clinical work and teaching—to join this series and share their insights.
They all graduated from Lesley University and bring decades of experience. They are not only experts, but also pioneers—people who have witnessed and shaped the field from its early beginnings to where it is today.
To make listening easier, this series will be released in two versions: a Chinese voiceover version and the original English audio. You can choose whichever feels right for you.
🔗China–U.S. Expressive Arts Therapy training program
我们今天邀请到的特别嘉宾—— Keren Shechter 博士是一位注册表达性艺术治疗师（REAT），专注于心理剧方向，拥有超过25年的临床与实践经验，长期在学校、社区及心理健康服务系统中，与儿童、青少年及成人工作。她目前任教于美国莱斯利大学 Lesley University 表达性治疗项目，同时也在 William James College 和 Cambridge College 授课，致力于培养新一代表达性艺术治疗专业人才。她的工作融合艺术、身体与关系，通过创造性的方式，支持人们更深入地理解自我、连接TA人。
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
从今天开始，我们的《艺术救心丸》将推出一个为期两个月的“表达性艺术EAT大师解答”系列，我个人作为中美表达性艺术治疗系统培训项目国内的一期毕业学员，十分荣幸邀请到6位全球表达性艺术领域的顶尖且资深的大师级、且在一线临床实践、教学的专家、教授为我们直接进行答疑解惑，TA们都毕业于表达性艺术治疗的学科原初发源地——美国莱斯利大学，都拥有几十年实践和教学经验，是这个学科从无到有、到稳步发展的前辈、亲历者。
为了方便大家的收听，我们的这个系列节目将分为中文模拟VO和英文原音两个版本同时发布，你可以根据自己的喜好进行收听版本的选择。
__________
主播：@笛笛：有着7年的心理咨询执业经历，个人执业心理咨询师 ｜ EGS瑞士欧洲研究生院表达性艺术博士在读 | 北京大学临床心理学硕士 ｜ 中国心理学会注册系统注册心理师 ｜北京知名高校心理咨询师 ｜ 在成为心理咨询师之前，拥有15年的影视娱乐及传播行业工作经验，曾任职于全球500强企业和国内一线电影公司管理岗位，参与策划、制作、营销多部国内外知名影片。
